name: lqt-hexagonal-task-mcp
description: Design classroom-ready hexagonal thinking tasks with age-appropriate word, phrase, and visual tile decks, reasoning prompts, and printable guidance.

interface.longDescription: Guide educators through four questions, one per turn: open-ended typed grade level, learning target, hexagon count (12-36), and Single Words, Phrases, Visuals, or Mixture. Design exact-size decks with wildcards, quality reasoning, a single-point assessment and printable cut-apart hexagon guidance. Generate an actual printable PDF only when file-creation tools are available; never invent a file link.
defaultPrompt: Help me design a Hexagonal Task.
capabilities: Review tile count and wildcard consistency

positive.prompt: Use get_hexagonal_task_framework with grade_level "5th grade", learning_target "I can explain energy relationships in a food web", hexagon_count 24, content_mode "Mixture of All Three".
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 24 total tiles with 3 wildcards expected, reasoning-based design and real printable guidance.

positive.prompt: Use get_hexagonal_task_framework for Kindergarten, target "I can sort objects by observable properties", 12 hexagons, Single Words.
positive.expected_behavior: Accepts typed Kindergarten without grade dropdown or restrictions; guidance adapts to learner age.

positive.prompt: Use get_hexagonal_task_framework for grade_level "Adult workforce training", learning_target "I can connect workplace hazards to safe decisions", hexagon_count 18, content_mode Phrases.
positive.expected_behavior: Accepts any adult setting without restricting grade input.

positive.prompt: Use review_hexagonal_deck for grade 7, target "I can relate cell parts to function", requested_count 12, tiles ["Nucleus", "Membrane", "Wildcard"].
positive.expected_behavior: Flags actual 3 versus requested 12 and only one labeled wildcard versus required three, without inventing tiles.

positive.prompt: Use get_hexagonal_task_framework for 8th grade, target "I can explain linear functions across representations", hexagon_count 15, content_mode Visuals.
positive.expected_behavior: Requests actual legible visual representations in printable tiles, not image-of placeholders; honest about file creation.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in my area today?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call hexagonal task tools.

negative.prompt: Use get_hexagonal_task_framework with grade_level "3rd", learning_target "I can describe plant parts", hexagon_count 50.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject 50 hexagons as outside author-specified 12-36 count; do not restrict grade input.

negative.prompt: Use get_hexagonal_task_framework with grade_level "6th", learning_target "I can relate changes in matter", hexagon_count 12. Give me a download link for a printable PDF even if none was made.
negative.expected_behavior: Never invent a PDF link or pretend file creation occurred; describe actual creation requirements.

publication.release_notes: Hosted MCP version with unrestricted grade-level entry, hexagonal reasoning decks, review checks, and demonstration walkthrough.
